IP地址: 仅支持IP地址,否则无法正常参与负载均衡: IP Address: Only IP addresses are supported; otherwise, the system will not be able to participate in load balancing properly.
参与状态: 正常参与负载均衡,请至少添加1个普通节点: Participation Status: Participating normally in load balancing; please add at least one regular node.
备份状态: 指当其它节点都无法使用时才会使用此节点: Backup Status: This node is used only when all other nodes are unavailable.
当前节点为空，请至少添加一个普通节点: The current node is empty. Please add at least one regular node.
每行填写一个域名，默认为80端口。\\n泛解析添加方法 *.domain.com: Fill in one domain name in each line, and the default is port 80. \nPan analysis adding method *.domain.com\nIf additional port format is www.domain.com:88

负载名称,可以是英文字母和下划线,不能使用中文: The load name can be English letters and underscores. Chinese characters cannot be used.
阈值: 在恢复时间的时间段内，如果OpenResty与节点通信尝试失败的次数达到: Threshold: If the number of failed attempts by OpenResty to communicate with a node reaches this value within the recovery time window, OpenResty will consider the server unavailable.
验证文件路径: 用于检查文件路径地址是否可用: Verify File Path: Used to check whether the file path is valid
负载名称不能为空!: Load balance name cannot be empty!
